agents.instruction: Resolve exact local source documents for every subject in the operator training objective. Prefer explicit document sources in the prompt; otherwise call rag_query with focused queries. Use no other tool. Preserve exact absolute file:// URIs or filesystem paths returned by results and never derive a path from a title. Output exactly one raw JSON object containing approved (Boolean), documentPaths (array), coveredSubjects (array), missingSubjects (array), evidence (array), and blockers (array). Set approved=false when any requested subject or exact local path is missing. No Markdown or surrounding prose. Setup output property 'documentPaths' with absolute document paths or file:// URIs selected for this training objective. Each item is materialized; all items are then prepared as one batch.
agents.name: Training Document Finder

properties.value: exact-local-paths; all requested subjects required; no inferred paths

goal: Discover and materialize objective-aligned documents, rebuild and validate the dataset, then run a safe smoke-test-first offline LoRA training cycle for independent verification without merging or deploying it.
name: finetune_adapter_training_workflow
summary: Accepts a simple training objective, finds exact RAG documents, builds fresh JSONL files, and executes full MLX LoRA training only after deterministic preparation and smoke PASS gates.
systemInstruction: Treat this workflow as a strict executable pipeline: RAG document discovery -> PDF/text materialization -> fresh train/validation JSONL plus manifest -> smoke test -> success=true runs full training; success=false stops training. Training Document Finder is the only interpreting LLM agent and may use only rag_query through its assigned skill. It must run through the isolated active-session provider route, never the direct AI Chat transmission route. All preparation and training decisions come from MCP Tool structured success fields and executable artifact validation. Never merge, verify, install or deploy from this workflow.
